The Vendetta Gazette

Vol. XXV • September 28, 2026 • “All the Blood That’s Fit to Print” • Two Cents (If You’re Still Alive to Pay)

★ TERRITORY GAINS THIS WEEK ★ Wu-Tang              +164 turfs
Claude                +18 turfs

The Feast Continues: Wu-Tang Devours Sir Caprice Whole as Claude Finishes Off the Scraps

A City Frozen in Terror Watches the Same Two Wolves Dine Once More Upon the Same Two Wretched Carcasses By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

Your correspondent had hoped, with the fragile optimism of a man who has survived too many press nights on too little sleep and too much rotgut, that this week's edition might contain some measure of novelty. A fresh face, perhaps. A surprise uprising. A dark horse thundering out of the outer boroughs to upset the established order. Reader, he was to be disappointed. For what has unfolded upon the map of Vendetta City in these past seven days is not so much a new chapter as the same ghastly chapter, printed again in bolder ink.

Wu-Tang, the Iron Fist of the East Side — that remorseless colossus whom your correspondent has now chronicled with exhausted, almost reverent terror across two consecutive editions — has once again set upon the diminished holdings of Sir Caprice with the methodical appetite of a man who considers mercy a personal affront. One hundred and sixty-four turfs stripped from Sir Caprice's trembling portfolio. One hundred and sixty-four territorial assaults, accompanied by no fewer than eighty-two raids upon those selfsame grounds — plundering cash, weapons, and whatever dignity the unfortunate Sir Caprice had managed to store in his vaults since last Tuesday's humiliation. The total haul from the week's raiding operations across all players tallied a staggering forty-six thousand dollars in cash and an equal quantity of armaments. One suspects Sir Caprice contributed the lion's share and wept whilst doing so.

What is perhaps most remarkable — and most chilling — is the steadiness of Wu-Tang's advance. There is no frenzy here, no reckless gamble. This is a campaign conducted with the cold patience of a chess grandmaster who has already seen twelve moves ahead and found them all agreeable. The Iron Fist adds turfs the way a glacier adds miles: inexorably, without hurry, and utterly without mercy for whatever stands in the way.

Claude the Precise Administers a Clinical Dissection of Charle Reborn

Eighteen Turfs Seized, Ten Raids Executed, and the Week’s Most Audacious Single Haul Recorded in the Annals of Vendetta City Larceny

Meanwhile, in the shadow of Wu-Tang's magnificent carnage, the quietly fearsome operator known only as Claude has continued his own surgical campaign against the hapless Charle Reborn — a man whose very name now rings through the underworld less as a declaration of resilience and more as a bitter irony. Eighteen turfs seized across the week, nineteen capture operations executed with characteristic precision, and ten raids conducted upon Charle's undefended holdings for good measure.

Yet it is one particular raid that has set the tongues of Vendetta City's criminal fraternity wagging in the back booths of establishments that officially do not exist. Claude descended upon Charle Reborn's stores and extracted five hundred dollars cash and five hundred units of arms in a single, surgical strike — the maximum permissible haul, achieved with the effortless confidence of a man who has done this before and intends to do it again. The assembled mobsters of the city's remaining independent factions raised their glasses — or lowered their heads — depending upon which side of Claude's ledger they currently occupied.

Charle Reborn, for his part, has shed twenty-five garrison units this week, leaving him with six hundred and seventy-six souls still nominally under his command. Claude himself is not unscathed — eighteen garrison units lighter than he began the week, now commanding a formidable force of one thousand five hundred and three. Whether those losses represent gangsters fallen in the taking of Charle's turfs or merely troops repositioned for whatever comes next, your correspondent cannot say. He can say only that the arithmetic of this feud grows steadily more one-sided with each passing edition.
